name: SPGISpeech: Financial-Domain Speech Recognition Corpus
description: SPGISpeech is a speech corpus of 5,000 hours of professionally transcribed corporate earnings calls in Western English, created by Kensho Technologies. It provides synchronized orthographic text formatted to S&P Global Capital IQ editorial standards, presenting a high-utility benchmark for automated transcription of domain-specific financial terminology, acronyms, and enterprise numbers.
